summary: CSX Corporation filed an 8-K on May 14, 2026, reporting two items: Item 5.02 (departure of a named officer) and Item 5.07 (Annual Meeting voting results). CFO Stephen Fortune separated immediately, eligible for severance under a prior plan; Steve Watkins assumes his role. This officer departure appears orderly, not forced/abrupt. The meeting results show routine elections and advisory votes. No special-situation transaction is present—no M&A, tender, spin-off, activist campaign, or similar event. The filing is a routine current report covering ordinary personnel and governance matters. There is no deal, no price per share, no premium, and no regulatory or risk-arb angle to monitor. Beyond the description, no further analysis is warranted.
